name: Explain request - code explanation
description: explain_action matches a request that asks for an explanation of code
query: Can you explain what this function does and why it is written this way?

name: Fix request - bug repair
description: fix_action matches a request that asks to repair a bug
query: This test keeps failing, can you fix the bug in the authentication logic?

name: Generate request - new code
description: generate_action matches a request that asks to write new code
query: Write me a function that parses a CSV file and returns the unique values in a column

name: Other request - no action
description: A request that names no action should not trigger any action decision
query: What is the capital of France?
